cost._: Hard per-run ceiling on MEASURED spend (review F10); the run raises CostGateError mid-flight if exceeded, keeping artifacts for resume.

execution._mode: batch default per Matt 2026-08-11: the 50% batch discount confirmed for DeepSeek on together's pricing -- true batch cost ~$0.047 vs concurrent $0.071 on the head-to-head fixture. Switch to concurrent when in a hurry (1.4x faster wall-clock).

_transcript_continuity: ds3: Matt's original architecture -- the divider instance itself performs the unwind (transcript reconstructed deterministically; prefix cache covers brief+D-user from the divide call). The driver had silently dropped this; restored 2026-08-11.
_golden_graph: Item 14 (Matt 2026-08-14): path to a golden graph (e.g. "recurse/root/graph.json", relative to graph_v2/). When set (or via --golden), post_build_checks additionally runs graph_compare -> <run>/compare_vs_golden.json, repair_census over the run, and the edge name-prose similarity histogram -> <run>/edge_similarity.json. All offline/deterministic, $0. null = off.

frontier_review._price_note: MEASURED from together /v1/models 2026-08-13 (EXPERIMENTS tier spot check): Kimi-K3 $3/$15 per Mtok; batch bills 50% but the gate uses list rate (worst-case doctrine)

_frontier_review: frontier_review.py (Matt's ruling 2026-08-14: the K3 pass is a pipeline stage). Reads <run>/risk_queue.json; the WHOLE worst case (parity + slice) is gated up front, before any spend (adversarial review item 1c); then parity vs the flash seat (divergence above the band STOPS loudly, seat-defect doctrine; a passed report persists for resume); then the top-`slice` items by risk as ONE batch. price_per_mtok is REQUIRED (no code default -- review item 1a: the gate is only as honest as its price); [3.0, 15.0] is the corrected K3 price, and max_cost_usd 3.00 covers the 150-slice worst case ($2.57 at this price). Requires explicit --yes: it spends real money.
